combo_label: The Sunday Roast × Horses & Riding × Peter Pan

entries.clue: Short curved sword swung by a buccaneer boarding a prize
Call meaning stop, addressed to the animal and not the driver
Silver-plated holder for the seasoning pots, brought out with the best tablecloth
Rank of Barrie's hook-handed pirate, in charge of the whole crew
Of potato edges, crunchy rather than soggy; Findus made pancakes of this kind
Spotted type developed by the Nez Perce people of the American north-west
Grown woman cast as the boy on the boards, a custom since 1904
Foot iron hung on a leather; a tiny bone of the middle ear shares the name
Jockey's satin colours; Elizabeth II's were purple and scarlet with gold braid
Pair of straps from bit to hands; let them go slack and you lose the steering
Thickened pan juices, poured brown over spuds and meat alike
One sixtieth of a minute, or the one to the right in Peter's directions to Neverland
Little green spheres tipped from a freezer bag, chased round the plate with a fork
